title: DE-07/2025/090 - Departmental Tests - July, 2025 [Translation from English to Tamil and Translation from Tamil to English] (Time 2 hours, 100 marks)
questions: 1. Translate into Tamil: A book is the best friend in human life. It gives us knowledge, experience, thought and emotion. From ancient times until today, reading books has played a major role in the growth of human society. Science, history, arts and literature have all been passed down from generation to generation through books. By reading books, our knowledge expands. We learn new words, sentences, ideas and information. This improves our language skills and thinking ability. From childhood itself, one should cultivate the habit of reading. It will be very helpful in succeeding in school education and competitive examinations. Moreover, reading gives us mental peace. It helps us forget tiredness and provides new motivation. Through books, we learn about the lifestyles, cultures and thoughts of people living in different parts of the world. This nurtures qualities like compassion, unity and tolerance within us in today's digital era, devices like the internet and mobile phones take up much of our time. But no device can give the joy and deep benefits of reading books. Therefore, we should develop the habit of reading books at least for a few minutes every day. A book is a priceless best friend that makes our life more knowledgeable, elevates our culture and shapes us into good human beings.
